hero.heading: Code Trails
hero.subheading: A self-contained path through your code, with all the context to understand it. Any browser. Open it and everything's already there.

frameIo.heading: Open it like you'd open a video.
frameIo.body: Four synchronized views. File City shows where. Sequence shows how. Code shows what. Plain English explains why. Click one, the others follow. Click a line, leave a note, right where it belongs.

makeFor.heading: Make a trail when you need:
makeFor.body: Trails are a byproduct of working, not extra work. See an example trail.

trails.description: Showing another team how a project actually works, as a link they can open.

trails.tag: A second opinion when you're stuck
trails.description: An hour fighting the agent, "I don't even know what to ask it." Solved once the right person could see the trail.

trails.tag: When the decision needs context you don't have
trails.description: An architecture choice that needed the customer and budget picture, weighed in on the exact step.
Following a real feature through the code, one step at a time.

flowRhythm.eyebrow: BUILT FOR TEAMS THAT BUILD TOGETHER
flowRhythm.heading: When the whole team understands it,
flowRhythm.body: Agents made one person fast. Code Trails make the whole team keep pace. One link at a time, understanding stops living in one head and starts compounding into something everyone can find, follow, and build on.

cards.label: SHARED AWARENESS
cards.title: Everyone sees what got built.
cards.description: Why it matters, where it lives, how it works. The context that makes code make sense, available to the whole team.

cards.label: DURABLE KNOWLEDGE
cards.description: Every trail makes the next one easier. One link at a time, your team gets smarter about its own code.

cards.label: COLLECTIVE CONFIDENCE
cards.description: When understanding is shared, confidence is too. Decisions stop living in one head and become something the whole team owns.

forBuilders.heading: Make your own Trail
forBuilders.body: Drop this prompt into your agent.
forBuilders.prompt: Read the author-local-investigation-trail skill at https://github.com/principal-ai/skills/blob/main/author-local-investigation-trail/SKILL.md and use it to walk me through <topic> locally as an investigation trail.
forBuilders.downloadText: Get the desktop app for the full File City experience.

closer.quote: Built by engineers who got tired of clone-the-repo to answer one question.
